races.name: Ballylinch Stud Irish EBF Ingabelle Stakes (Fillies' Listed)
races.verdict:
TIMELESS TALE possibly didn't beat much on her debut at Naas but was still most impressive and, with the performance supported by a strong timefigure, she looks capable of taking the rise in grade in her stride on the way to even better things. Maire Rua is bred to be smart and remains one to be positive about having not been seen to best effect on her first try at listed level at Cork. Ibelieveicanfly is much respected back down in grade, too.

  1. TIMELESS TALE (IRE)
  2. MAIRE RUA
  3. IBELIEVEICANFLY (USA)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Sovereign Path Handicap (Premier Handicap)
races.verdict:
VAFORTINO has shaped better than the bare result in valuable handicaps at Royal Ascot and Galway the last twice, looking unlucky not to win latterly. Well treated on past form, he can end his losing run granted better luck. Gleneagle Bay, also better than the result at Galway, rates the main danger from 3 lb lower, with Collecting Coin and Fort Vega also respected. Any market support for last year’s winner Rahmi would be well worth noting.

  1. VAFORTINO (IRE)
  2. GLENEAGLE BAY (IRE)
  3. COLLECTING COIN

races.name: HKJC World Pool Golden Fleece Stakes (Group 1)
races.verdict:
DARKNESS FALLS looked a smart one when running away with a Curragh maiden 2 weeks ago, and he's fancied to enhance Aidan O'Brien's outstanding record in this event. Green Dreamer is feared most on the back of his third behind top prospect Giant Sequoia. Nola Soul needs considering following his close fourth in the same race, while Pikachu makes each-way appeal at the forecast prices.

  1. DARKNESS FALLS (IRE)
  2. GREEN DREAMER (IRE)
  3. PIKACHU

races.name: World Pool Bet With The Tote Kilternan Stakes (Group 3)
races.verdict:
PURVIEW was only pushed out to win at this level at the Curragh last time and Dermot Weld's colt looks capable of defying a penalty and making it 4 wins in a row. Green Impact is highly respected after going close in the Ballyroan, whilst In My Teens and Thread of Gold both appeal as ones who should prove capable of making an impact in this better company.

  1. PURVIEW
  2. GREEN IMPACT (IRE)
  3. IN MY TEENS (IRE)

races.name: Coolmore America 'Justify' Matron Stakes (Fillies' And Mares' Group 1)
races.verdict:
BLUE BOLT has got the better of Precise in Group 1s on her last 2 starts so she'll be hard to beat again with this race having reportedly been her main target for a while. Precise rates the main threat again back on home soil, though the unexposed City of Memphis probably has more to offer still.

  1. BLUE BOLT (IRE)
  2. PRECISE (IRE)
  3. CITY OF MEMPHIS (IRE)

races.name: TonyBet Solonaway Stakes (Group 2)
races.verdict:
ISAAC NEWTON got back on the up in no uncertain terms when landing a C&D Group 3 from a number of these rivals last month. Still lightly raced at 1m, he's fancied to make another bold bid. Quddwah was in fine form in Meydan earlier in the year and he's a big threat boasting an excellent record fresh. Faiyum and Power Blue are also in the mix.

  1. ISAAC NEWTON (IRE)
  2. QUDDWAH
  3. FAIYUM

races.name: Royal Bahrain Irish Champion Stakes (Group 1)
races.verdict:
Having done well to land the Juddmonte International at York last month, ITEM is fancied to confirm the form with the potential for even better still to come. The son of Frankel can see off the challenge of Constitution River, who isn't taken lightly in his bid to add to Aidan O'Brien's excellent record in this race, with Almaqam also in the mix in a fascinating renewal.

  1. ITEM
  2. CONSTITUTION RIVER (FR)
  3. ALMAQAM

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Petingo Handicap (Premier Handicap)
races.verdict:
This is wide open but IMMUTABLE rates just the pick of the weights on the back of a very good Galway second and is taken to end his losing run. Aidan O'Brien's Port of Spain heads the list of dangers in search of his own first success of the season, although Truth Be Told, This Songisforyou and Wyman also need factoring into this highly competitive handicap.

  1. IMMUTABLE (IRE)
  2. PORT OF SPAIN (IRE)
  3. TRUTH BE TOLD (IRE)

races.name: World Pool Bet With Tote Autumn Fillies Handicap (Premier Handicap)
races.verdict:
As anticipated for the prize money on offer this looks fiendishly competitive. Preference is for THRIFTY OF DIGBY, who has run her race more often than not this year, and Jessica Harrington's mare couldn't have gone much closer to adding to her tally here last time. Suzie Songs heads up the dangers arriving on a hat-trick for her handicap debut, with Rebel Wave, Bella Colombia and Aviatrice just a handful of others worth considering, too.

  1. THRIFTY OF DIGBY (IRE)
  2. SUZIE SONGS (IRE)
  3. REBEL WAVE (IRE)

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Str)
races.verdict:
GAME CHARACTER made a promising start to his career when fifth in the most valuable maiden in Britain at York 3 weeks ago, and he shades the vote over Hmas Perth, who also showed plenty when third in a maiden at the Galway Festival.

  1. GAME CHARACTER
  2. HMAS PERTH (USA)
  3. AL JABBAR (IRE)

races.name: Betfred Champagne Stakes (Group 2)
races.verdict:
DESERT CASTLE created a most favourable impression when making an impressive winning start to his career at Newmarket last month and, open to oodles of improvement, he's fancied to overcome the rise in grade and keep his unbeaten record intact. Gentle Hurricane ran a cracker in the Acomb considering his inexperience and appeals as the type to go on progressing, while promising Ballydoyle colt Sergei Diaghilev is another serious contender commanding plenty of respect.

  1. DESERT CASTLE
  2. GENTLE HURRICANE (IRE)
  3. SERGEI DIAGHILEV (IRE)

races.name: Betfred Portland (Heritage Handicap)
races.verdict:
A typically competitive-looking renewal, with preference for TWILIGHT CALLS who was value for extra when making it 3 wins from his last 4 starts at Goodwood in July. Toca Madera wasted no time getting back to form when runner-up at the same course 2 weeks ago and could be the main danger, with Al Shabab Storm and Getreadytorumble completing the shortlist.

  1. TWILIGHT CALLS
  2. TOCA MADERA (IRE)
  3. AL SHABAB STORM

races.name: Betfred Park Stakes (Group 2)
races.verdict:
MORE THUNDER was a shade disappointing in the Prix Jacques le Marois at Deauville last month, but he stands out on the pick of his form now back at Group 2 level. He can return to winning ways, perhaps at the expense of Flora of Bermuda, who should find this slightly less demanding than the City of York Stakes. Qirat can fill the places.

  1. MORE THUNDER (IRE)
  2. FLORA OF BERMUDA (IRE)
  3. QIRAT

races.name: Betfred St Leger Stakes (Group 1)
races.verdict:
This test is likely to bring out the best in CHRISTMAS DAY given the manner of his gruelling Derby victory and his 2 starts subsequently, so he can provide Aidan O'Brien with a fourth straight win in Britain's oldest Classic. Joseph O'Brien saddles the progressive pair Enceladus and Highwayman, with the former looking the strongest challenger on form, while the selection's stablemate Pierre Bonnard should be on the premises again.

  1. CHRISTMAS DAY (IRE)
  2. ENCELADUS (IRE)
  3. PIERRE BONNARD (IRE)

races.name: Pertemps Network Handicap (Str)
races.verdict:
No shortage of chances in a cracking handicap but thriving 4-y-o INSPIRED escapes a penalty for last week's York success and can cope with the rise in class and make it 4 wins from his last 5 starts. Britannia scorer Moonfall ran right up to his best when second back at Ascot last time and he's feared. William Haggas pair Bullet Point and Scoville are others to consider, with Blue Courvoisier and Fifth Column completing an exhaustive shortlist.

  1. INSPIRED (IRE)
  2. MOONFALL (IRE)
  3. BULLET POINT

races.name: PJ Towey Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
A case can be made for plenty of these but top-weight THUNDER RUN is taken to gain a deserved first success of the season after a series of very good efforts in top handicap company. Windsor scorer City of Poets remains unexposed at this distance and could emerge as the main danger, although Irish challenger Touch The Moon and the handily-weighted Tony Montana also need factoring in.

  1. THUNDER RUN (IRE)
  2. CITY OF POETS (IRE)
  3. TOUCH THE MOON (IRE)

races.name: No Napier No Party Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
BOOK OF LIFE went down as an unlucky loser for a second start in a row at Newcastle recently so, granted better luck in-running, Patrick Morris' 6-y-o gets the verdict to belatedly double his tally at the expense of King Sharja, who has found one too strong 3 times this season and may be adding another silver medal to his collection. Thats My Boy Luke can edge out Approaching Dawn for third.

  1. BOOK OF LIFE
  2. KING SHARJA
  3. THATS MY BOY LUKE

races.name: EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
William Haggas has a 70% strike rate in 2-y-o maiden/novice races at this track and his EXTRAGALACTIC should go one better than on debut at Yarmouth. Vegasmile and Showcasing Glory look the most likely dangers.

  1. EXTRAGALACTIC (IRE)
  2. VEGASMILE (IRE)
  3. SHOWCASING GLORY (IRE)

races.name: Royal Regiment Of Scotland Trophy Nursery
races.verdict:
NEEDIN' U looks capable of defying a 9-lb rise, and she's taken to make it 2-2 in nurseries here. Royal Strike and Star People are both feared.

  1. NEEDIN' U
  2. ROYAL STRIKE (IRE)
  3. STAR PEOPLE (FR)

races.name: Jewson Edinburgh Selling Handicap
races.verdict:
A significant drop in class could be the catalyst for CALLIANASSA to record a first success on turf. The main danger is Sunriseontheboyne, who's still potentially well treated on the back of his Newcastle victory, while Bee Farmer may make more impact if settling off the likely strong pace.

  1. CALLIANASSA (IRE)
  2. SUNRISEONTHEBOYNE (IRE)
  3. BEE FARMER

races.name: Peterhead Fish Market Handicap
races.verdict:
BLACK STORM may be able to follow up his victory in this grade at Catterick last month. Carolus Magnus is likely to have a big say returning to a course where he excels, with Vince Le Prince, Coconut Bay and Masaban others to consider in a competitive handicap.

  1. BLACK STORM (IRE)
  2. CAROLUS MAGNUS (IRE)
  3. VINCE LE PRINCE

races.name: Scots Association Musselburgh Gold Cup Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
Following a hat-trick of seconds, FAST FRED may deservedly get his head back in front. The main danger is likely to come from hat-trick seeker Boxing Great, who could still have more to offer as a stayer.

  1. FAST FRED
  2. BOXING GREAT (IRE)
  3. WAHRAAN (FR)

races.name: Lothian Supply Company Handicap
races.verdict:
A tough call to split SO GRATEFUL and Ski Angel, with the former narrowly preferred off his attractive-looking handicap mark.

  1. SO GRATEFUL
  2. SKI ANGEL
  3. ROYAL DUKE

races.name: Big Stage Hire 'Confined' Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
races.verdict:
ARUNDEL proved he retains all his ability after nearly a year off when third at Yarmouth 13 days ago and a reproduction of that form may well suffice back down in grade. Stintino Sunset and Revich are more consistent than most at this level and they head the opposition.

  1. ARUNDEL (IRE)
  2. STINTINO SUNSET
  3. REVICH (IRE)

races.name: Andersons Commercial & Domestic Drainage Specialists Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
DIALSTONE and Colonnade look the obvious pair to focus on. The former bumped into an exciting prospect at Kempton last month and is well worth another chance to confirm his debut promise. Soul of Appin makes some appeal on paper and is worth a market check ahead of her belated debut for an in-form stable.

  1. DIALSTONE
  2. COLONNADE (IRE)
  3. SOUL OF APPIN

races.name: Best Betting Sites At freebets.com EBF 'Confined' Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
BAARBERINI was unlucky to bump into a promising newcomer at Southwell last month and is well worth another chance to open his account. Cracking Idea should have more to offer now stepping up to 1m, while the same applies to Able Tasman, who has been off since making an encouraging start to his career in the spring. Trispen is a debutant to keep an eye on in the betting.

  1. BAARBERINI
  2. CRACKING IDEA (IRE)
  3. ABLE TASMAN (IRE)

races.name: Andersons Drainage Solutions Supporting Bath Racecourse Nursery
races.verdict:
A competitive nursery. KNOCK THREE TIMES didn't enjoy the rub of the green when fifth at Lingfield last time and is fancied to quickly resume winning ways at the chief expense of hat-trick seeking PJ's Corner, who rates a big threat. Amber Ocean and Space Dreamer look capable of further progress and can also play a prominent role.

  1. KNOCK THREE TIMES (IRE)
  2. PJ'S CORNER
  3. AMBER OCEAN

races.name: Alliance Wales & West Handicap
races.verdict:
Lots of these arrive with a question mark against them so this looks a good opportunity for MAKE A SPLASH to build on her improved Ffos Las third and gain a first success. Fram Castle rates the obvious threat on the back of a recent course victory ahead of in-form La Trinite.

  1. MAKE A SPLASH (IRE)
  2. FRAM CASTLE (IRE)
  3. LA TRINITE

races.name: Andersons Drainage Serving The South West Handicap
races.verdict:
SOME NIGHTMARE is on a long losing run but can race off the same mark as when a clear second at Chepstow recently so gets the nod over Alshimali who made an encouraging return from an absence when fourth at Wolverhampton and should strip sharper here. May Encounter is edging down the weights and can also have a say.

  1. SOME NIGHTMARE (IRE)
  2. ALSHIMALI (IRE)
  3. MAY ENCOUNTER

races.name: Alec Smith Is Getting Married Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
This is wide open but MEDYG has been dropped 3 lb by the official assessor having not been seen to anything like best effect when sixth at Ffos Las last time out so edges the vote. Arvana Belle came in a resurgent second that day and is feared most, while Oh So Audacious can also have a say.

  1. MEDYG
  2. ARVANA BELLE (IRE)
  3. OH SO AUDACIOUS

races.name: Alec Smith Is Getting Married Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
WHO IS ALICE found things a bit easier taking on her elders for the first time when third over C&D recently and is put forward as the answer from a 2 lb lower mark, especially with a handy 5-lb claimer now taking over in the saddle. Amarachi shaped better than the distance beaten suggests on last month's return at Beverley and must enter calculations in first-time cheekpieces, while Freedom Bay, a C&D winner earlier in the summer, can also figure if casting aside a lesser effort at Lingfield.

  1. WHO IS ALICE
  2. AMARACHI (IRE)
  3. FREEDOM BAY

races.name: Alan Rae Smith Errant Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
AFFETTUOSO has already run to a fairly useful level so Roger Varian's charge is expected to take some stopping with further improvement on the cards now tackling this longer trip. Astrid showed much more than she had first time up last time, so she rates as the obvious danger, while Electric Arc has been given time since her debut back in the spring and could leave that initial outing behind.

  1. AFFETTUOSO
  2. ASTRID (FR)
  3. ELECTRIC ARC

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Handicap
races.verdict:
PACE ATTACK progressed further when making his second handicap start a winning one at Southwell recently and he is taken to score again now that he's up and running. James Choice was only narrowly denied at Wolverhampton on his latest outing and is feared most, while Zarco could fare better this time around.

  1. PACE ATTACK (IRE)
  2. JAMES CHOICE
  3. ZARCO

races.name: Happy 60th Jacqueline Handicap
races.verdict:
VICTORY SOUND wasn't all out when doubling his tally at Newcastle last week and a 2 lb rise back up in the weights might not be enough to prevent him from following up. He gets the vote ahead of Taskheer, who ran well when third here on his stable debut, and dual course winner Chico Dulce.

  1. VICTORY SOUND (IRE)
  2. TASKHEER (IRE)
  3. CHICO DULCE

races.name: Follow AtTheRaces On Instagram Handicap
races.verdict:
YAZOO ran out a clear-cut winner on handicap debut at Wolverhampton just 5 days ago, showing no sign of previous quirks, and is fancied to build on that breakthrough despite the quick turnaround under a penalty. Creciente continues in good heart and returns to Lingfield, though on the all-weather this time, whilst Aurelune confirmed her improvement when second at Hamilton 10 days ago and should take a hand.

  1. YAZOO
  2. CRECIENTE
  3. AURELUNE (IRE)

races.name: Free Race Replays On attheraces.com Handicap
races.verdict:
LAW OF AVERAGE blitzed her rivals when making all over C&D in early July, posting a career best and is fancied to follow up now back on all-weather having disappointed under a penalty on turf at Hamilton. Tatterstall regressed at Goodwood but sports first-time cheekpieces and merits respect back on this surface, while Kylian could be the one to benefit if the leaders go too hard in a race with bags of speed in it.

  1. LAW OF AVERAGE
  2. TATTERSTALL (IRE)
  3. KYLIAN (IRE)

races.name: Free Tips On attheraces.com Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
ANGELS' SHARE is very hard to overlook around here given she's won all 3 C&D starts and hails from a yard going well. Pennine Way is best excused her last run given the interference suffered and returns to 7f with claims, while Orange Emperor ran one of his better races in cheekpieces at Kempton recently.

  1. ANGELS' SHARE
  2. PENNINE WAY
  3. ORANGE EMPEROR (IRE)

races.name: Free Tips On attheraces.com Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
STRONG VOICE ran a cracker up against a well-treated rival last time and this looks a good opportunity for him to break his duck at the expense of Royal County Glory and Credit Forgedd It who were very closely matched here last month and look sure to go well again.

  1. STRONG VOICE (IRE)
  2. ROYAL COUNTY GLORY (IRE)
  3. CREDIT FORGEDD IT (IRE)

races.name: Fountain Workshop Celebration Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
ESPANITA has benefited from the fitting of a hood last 3 starts, doubling her tally at Wolverhampton and running well when third here 9 days ago, so she is fancied to resume winning ways. Buckland Belle arrives in good heart and could be the main danger, with Sunshine And Roses also considered.

  1. ESPANITA (IRE)
  2. BUCKLAND BELLE
  3. SUNSHINE AND ROSES

races.name: Follow AtTheRaces On X Handicap
races.verdict:
ICONIC DAWN has fared better in handicaps fitted with headgear the last twice and, now tried in cheekpieces, she could be ready to get off the mark back down in trip. Next on the list is Kyoto as he returns to all-weather for only his third handicap start, ahead of Henry Tudor.

  1. ICONIC DAWN
  2. KYOTO (IRE)
  3. HENRY TUDOR

races.name: Virgin Bet Stand Cup Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
DUBAI HONOUR proved he's still capable of very smart form in Australia over the winter and sets the standard down in grade. Plage de Havre and Too Soon arrive on the back of winning strong handicaps and they will pose the biggest threats.

  1. DUBAI HONOUR (IRE)
  2. PLAGE DE HAVRE
  3. TOO SOON

races.name: Virgin Bet Supports Safe Gambling Watergate Cup (Heritage Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
CRANACHAN looks a thorough stayer and Ralph Beckett's 3-y-o can make it back-to-back C&D successes. Irish raider Holy See is highly respected on the back of a career-best effort at Galway, whilst Stressfree is back in form and is lurking on a competitive mark.

  1. CRANACHAN
  2. HOLY SEE (IRE)
  3. STRESSFREE (FR)

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
NIGHT STAR has a less-than-ideal draw to navigate, yet he's shown more than enough to think a race of this nature is within his grasp and is selected to get off the mark turned out quickly. National Pride showed the benefit of his debut experience when second at Catterick and appeals as the chief danger with the prospect of more to come. Regency Royal is also a player judged on his promising debut effort over 6f here in July.

  1. NIGHT STAR (IRE)
  2. NATIONAL PRIDE (IRE)
  3. REGENCY ROYAL (GER)

races.name: H.R. Owen Lotus Manchester Nursery
races.verdict:
THIS MOMENT progressed again kept to the minimum trip when following up his breakthrough Newcastle victory at Thirsk 7 days ago and a bold bid to land the hat-trick looks on the cards from the plum draw in stall 1. Paper View looked an unlucky loser when third at Windsor on his latest outing 4 weeks ago and remains of interest, with Rotelle completing the shortlist in what is a competitive nursery.

  1. THIS MOMENT (IRE)
  2. PAPER VIEW (IRE)
  3. ROTELLE

races.name: Virgin Bet Every Saturday Money Back Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
The ex-Irish MANO CHICAGO was an eye-catcher on his debut for Iain Jardine last time and gets the verdict despite stall 10 being a bit of a concern. Impartiality, Shafdar and Star Cast all arrive in good form and are worth shortlisting in a competitive affair.

  1. MANO CHICAGO (IRE)
  2. IMPARTIALITY
  3. SHAFDAR (IRE)

races.name: Lee Martin 60th Birthday Celebration Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
On the face of it HOT CASH looks a tough one to recommend but there have been excuses for some recent below-par efforts and first-time cheekpieces could be just what are required to spark Jack Channon's 4-y-o back to life. He gets the tentative nod over Vixey, who goes well at this venue and arrives in good order. Veteran Tele Red warrants plenty of respect after an encouraging return but stall 10 may well scupper his chances.

  1. HOT CASH
  2. VIXEY
  3. TELE RED

races.name: Lee Martin 60th Birthday Celebration Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
CRAZEE ICON has already won twice at this venue this year and, with her latest effort easily excused, she is taken to prove her revised mark is still a favourable one and resume winning ways. The Resdev Scholar went close over C&D in June and looks the main danger, while Apache Outlaw is well handicapped on his best form if taking to the track.

  1. CRAZEE ICON
  2. THE RESDEV SCHOLAR (IRE)
  3. APACHE OUTLAW (IRE)

races.name: John Smith's Jump Jockeys Challenge Handicap (Professional Jump Jockeys) (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
NIBRAS GOLD won over C&D in a first-time tongue strap in July and, having shaped well at Brighton last time, is fancied to resume winning ways back at this venue. Loki impressed when making a winning handicap debut at Carlisle with a bit in hand and looks too well treated to ignore despite a high draw, so rates the main danger. Spartan Times is also respected.

  1. NIBRAS GOLD (IRE)
  2. LOKI (GER)
  3. SPARTAN TIMES

races.name: 4Racing Welcomes You Maiden Handicap
races.verdict:
STEEL PIER is in a good run of form and seems the one they have to beat. Mfulathela may be the best bet for second, while Revitalise heads up those chasing third place.

  1. STEEL PIER (SAF)
  2. MFULATHELA (SAF)
  3. REVITALISE (SAF)

races.name: youcanbetonus! Classified Stakes
races.verdict:
ROSY LEMON looks the way to go. Itsnowornever could be the main danger, while Utsaah can't be ruled out.

  1. ROSY LEMON (SAF)
  2. ITSNOWORNEVER (SAF)
  3. UTSAAH (SAF)

races.name: Play Soccer 6, 10 And 13 Novice Handicap
races.verdict:
KOVIL is promising and can win again. Top Floor is a danger, while Palace Attack can't be ruled out.

  1. KOVIL (SAF)
  2. TOP FLOOR (SAF)
  3. PALACE ATTACK (SAF)

races.name: Tab Telebet 011 074 0300 Conditions Plate
races.verdict:
CALLA LAGOON gets the vote. King Harald might be the answer to second place, while Pretty Persuasive shouldn't be discarded.

  1. CALLA LAGOON
  2. KING HARALD (SAF)
  3. PRETTY PERSUASIVE (SAF)

races.name: Racing240 Mr 101 Open Handicap (3 Year Olds)
races.verdict:
RIVERA is promising and can win again. Gimme A Fireball could give the selection most to think about, while Winter Voice looks third best.

  1. RIVERA (SAF)
  2. GIMME A FIREBALL (SAF)
  3. WINTER VOICE (SAF)

races.name: For Hospitality Bookings Call 011 681 1796 Novice Handicap
races.verdict:
DRIVELIKEAMASTER can come out on top back from a break. Little Boy Blue earns the vote for second, while Brigitte Anne is perhaps the most interesting of those left.

  1. DRIVELIKEAMASTER (SAF)
  2. LITTLE BOY BLUE (SAF)
  3. BRIGITTE ANNE (SAF)

races.name: www.tab.co.za Middle Stakes
races.verdict:
BRIGHT AND BRAZEN could be the one to beat. Precocious is top of the dangers, while The Last Duke is another to bear in mind.

  1. BRIGHT AND BRAZEN (SAF)
  2. PRECOCIOUS (SAF)
  3. THE LAST DUKE (SAF)

races.name: Next Turffontein Racemeeting Saturday 19 September Classified Stakes
races.verdict:
JACK'S LEGACY looks sure to progress and is much the one to aim at. Hot Choice is the second option, while Fish Hawk is another with a place chance.

  1. JACK'S LEGACY (SAF)
  2. HOT CHOICE (SAF)
  3. FISH HAWK (SAF)
